h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in Amarillo with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in Amarillo?
faqs.a: The court cost is typically up to about $144 ($169 in a school zone), set by each court. The TDLR-approved course is separate; ours is $28. Check your court's page for the exact amount.

faqs.q: Can I take the Amarillo defensive driving course online?
faqs.a: Yes. Once the court approves your request, a TDLR-approved 6-hour course can be completed fully online. Every Amarillo-area court accepts a state-approved online course.

faqs.q: My ticket is from Canyon, not Amarillo. Does that change things?
faqs.a: The legal steps are the same, but you deal with the Canyon Municipal Court (Randall County), with its own fee, request method, and deadlines. Open its page in the table above.

faqs.q: How long do I have to finish?
faqs.a: Generally 90 days after the court approves the request. Request the course by your appearance date first, and don't pay the ticket — paying is a guilty plea and a conviction.

faqs.q: Does a dismissal keep it off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A driving safety course dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record under Texas law, so it can't raise your insurance — unlike paying, which is a conviction.

courts.name: Amarillo Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Canyon Municipal Court
courts.note: Canyon (I-27, WTAMU) takes DSC requests in person, by mail, or email — order your Type 3A record early; 90 days, no extensions.

courts.name: Lake Tanglewood Municipal Court
courts.note: Got a ticket in Lake Tanglewood (Randall County, SE of Amarillo)? This small village hasn't posted its DSC fee online — call (806) 622-8711 by your appearance date to confirm eligibility and the court's admin fee.

courts.name: Palisades Village Of Municipal Court
courts.note: Got a ticket in Palisades (Randall County, just south of Amarillo near Palo Duro Canyon)? Palisades Municipal Court hasn't posted its DSC fee online — call (806) 359-1808 before your appearance date to request dismissal.

courts.name: Timbercreek Canyon Municipal Court
courts.note: Got a traffic ticket in Timbercreek Canyon (Randall County, just south of Amarillo near Palo Duro Canyon)? The court hasn't posted its DSC fee online — call (806) 443-7418 or email judge@timbercreekcanyontx.gov before your appearance date.
